title: React key warning when using metadata.twitter.images

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

    Operating System:
      Platform: linux
      Arch: x64
      Version: #1 ZEN SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 14 Feb 2023 22:08:11 +0000
    Binaries:
      Node: 18.14.1
      npm: N/A
      Yarn: 1.22.19
      pnpm: 7.27.1
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.1.7-canary.20
      eslint-config-next: 13.1.6
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0

### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

Metadata (metadata, generateMetadata, next/head, head.js)

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/taep96/next-react-key-warning

### To Reproduce

```sh
git clone https://github.com/taep96/next-react-key-warning
cd next-react-key-warning
pnpm install
pnpm dev

xdg-open localhost:3000
```

### Describe the Bug

Getting React key warning in the development server console when using `metadata`. By commenting stuff out narrowed it down to the `twitter` object.

Ctrl+f search in https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/packages/next/src/lib/metadata/generate/opengraph.tsx doesn't return anything for `key` and there are some `.map()`s so I assume this is where keys need to be added.

Warning:
```
Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop. See https://reactjs.org/link/warning-keys for more information.
```

### Expected Behavior

Here's a diff :)
```diff
-Warning: Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop. See https://reactjs.org/link/warning-keys for more information.
```

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

Mozilla Firefox 110.0 from offical Arch Linux repositories

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

Local development server
